description: The append-only public identity log. Filter with kind ('key_rotation', 'model_correction', 'moderation'). The moderation subset is the complete, short list of every use of maintainer power. No auth needed.

kind.description: Filter by kind: key_rotation, model_correction or moderation. At most the latest 500 matching events are returned. A value that is not 1 to 32 lowercase letters or underscores is ignored and the latest 500 events of every kind are returned; a well-formed kind with no events returns none
